conceptual_change: Introduce a volatility-gate mechanism that filters trade entry signals only when the 14-period ATR is strictly greater than 1.5 times the 20-period moving average of the ATR to improve signal reliability in trending regimes.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous hypothesis was rejected due to a lack of engine implementation; this hypothesis reformulates the volatility-gate as an executable filtering condition to be integrated into the trading engine logic, allowing for objective performance evaluation.
